#228 correctness review, round 1: PASS

Exact head: b0259b1987d3f829e5494cefa9e366d07404544b.

No correctness findings in the eight-file delta.

Verified the authoritative ruling in governance commit f078301c4a26e562ef5e87eae3fc273e413fc6cc: nice -n 19 only, shared-build serialization and the four-job default replace background QoS and the compile/run split.

shared-build now invokes each supplied cargo command exactly once through the nice-19 argv array. The executable taskpolicy wrapper and PIJ_SHARED_BUILD_TASKPOLICY lookup are removed. Tests and doctests take the same path; caller-supplied arguments, including -- and an explicit --no-run, are preserved rather than rewritten. The route-inventory recipe likewise has one explicit /usr/bin/nice -n 19 cargo test invocation, with no separate compile step.

The canonical target/lock identity, 0700 atomic mkdir admission, owner-line safeguards, stale-lock refusal, timeout, per-command disk-floor check, source touching, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, signal traps and whole-process-group drain-before-release are unchanged. The lock still spans the complete --then batch. PIJ_CARGO_JOBS defaults to four and still controls CARGO_BUILD_JOBS and the default RUST_TEST_THREADS; existing explicit overrides remain supported, as before. .cargo/config.toml retains its four-job/four-thread defaults. Command quoting and failure propagation remain unchanged.

A hidden-path sweep of operational scripts, extensions, skills, Rust sources, AGENTS.md and justfile found only explanatory prohibitions and the negative scheduling test, not another active taskpolicy wrapper. Historical plan/retro text and the annotated difficulty rows are intentionally historical, not operative build instructions. Scaled real-child budgets and PIJ_TEST_TIME_SCALE remain documented and unchanged.

Proof: clean detached worktree; just pr-freeze 228 returned FINAL with remote/GitHub head agreement, CLEAN and all latest checks passed. CI run 42929038558 is successful at this exact head. Both Node 22 and 24 job logs record shared-build.test.ts passing all 19 cases, including scheduling, caps, serialization, floor, stale lock, symlink/umask protections and signal descendant draining. The scheduling case puts a fake taskpolicy on PATH and at the retired seam, then observes one nice-19 build, test and doctest step without that wrapper or an inserted --no-run. Each Node suite totals 2,289 passed, six skipped. Rust lint/test also passed.

Reviewer-local bash -n harness/scripts/shared-build.sh, just --show route-inventory-check, just --show shared-build and git diff --check passed. No local real build, dependency install/symlink, product edit or daemon operation. No new daemon loop, poll, timer or launch. No notes owed.
